title: PLM volume/threshold audit

source.cohortOutcomesAndPeaks: Frozen CSV; statuses, peak prices, PnL, stop settings and cancellation fields were not rewritten
source.fireMetrics: tracked_signals.decision_metrics and entry_metrics_provenance; all primary queried sources are signal_fire
source.forwardPeak: pattern_decision_snapshots plus pattern_backfill_candles (15m OHLC), full window [fire, fire+72h), includes post-exit candles, rows clipped at frozen cutoff

queries.fireMetricRows:
SELECT
  t.id AS tracker_id, t.signal_id, t.symbol, t.detected_at, t.entry_policy_version,
  t.decision_metrics, t.entry_metrics_provenance,
  t.entry_spot_vol_mult, t.entry_fut_vol_mult, t.entry_oi_30m, t.entry_oi_1h,
  t.entry_oi_4h, t.entry_oi_24h, t.entry_cvd_15m, t.entry_cvd_30m,
  t.entry_cvd_1h, t.entry_cvd_4h, t.entry_fut_taker_net_buy,
  t.plm_oi30m_shadow, t.plm_fut_taker_shadow, t.entry_spot_net_buy_1h,
  t.entry_spot_net_buy_4h, t.entry_spot_taker_net_buy, t.entry_funding_rate,
  t.entry_btc_24h, t.entry_btc_dominance, t.entry_ob_ratio, t.entry_spot_mcap_pct,
  t.entry_spot_vol_24h, t.entry_price_1h
FROM tracked_signals AS t
WHERE t.id = ANY($1::integer[])
ORDER BY t.detected_at ASC;
queries.fixed72hPeak:
SELECT t.id AS tracker_id, t.symbol,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(t.original_entry_price, 0), t.entry_price) AS basis_price,
       d.entry_price AS snapshot_entry_price, d.id AS decision_snapshot_id,
       d.source, d.trajectory_status, d.trajectory_candle_count, d.decision_at,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.candle_at)::int AS candles_72h,
       MIN(c.candle_at) AS first_candle, MAX(c.candle_at) AS last_candle,
       MAX(c.high) AS max_high_72h, MIN(c.low) AS min_low_72h,
       MAX((c.high / NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.original_entry_price, 0), t.entry_price), 0) - 1) * 100) AS peak72_pct,
       (COUNT(DISTINCT c.candle_at) = 288 AND MAX(c.candle_at) >= d.decision_at + interval '72 hours' - interval '15 minutes') AS reaches_72h_endpoint
FROM tracked_signals AS t
LEFT JOIN pattern_decision_snapshots AS d
  ON d.tracked_signal_id = t.id AND d.decision_kind = 'fired'
 AND d.event_key = 'tracked:' || t.id::text
LEFT JOIN pattern_backfill_candles AS c
  ON c.decision_snapshot_id = d.id AND c.interval = '15m'
 AND c.candle_at >= d.decision_at
 AND c.candle_at < d.decision_at + interval '72 hours'
 AND c.candle_at <= '2026-10-01T04:36:43.459443Z'::timestamptz
WHERE t.id = ANY($1::integer[])
GROUP BY t.id, t.symbol, t.entry_price, t.original_entry_price, d.id,
         d.entry_price, d.source, d.trajectory_status,
         d.trajectory_candle_count, d.decision_at
ORDER BY t.detected_at ASC;

gateInputParity.definition: All recorded fire-time inputs pass documented p24h/p3h/spot-volume/SNF/CVD thresholds; this is not a stamped implementation-version cohort
gateInputParity.warning: The 6 mismatches have measured fire-time values, not unknowns. Gate version was not stored; compatible subset is an input-vector screen and must not be retroactively labeled as the deployed gate cohort.

shadowReadiness.legacyNullHandling: 147 legacy rows excluded from numerical classifications; NULL/unstamped is never mapped to zero, below-threshold or unavailable.
shadowReadiness.scope: Historical readiness estimates above describe only the single_entry_v1 cohort of 21 and must not be pooled with separate stored shadow-class counts over the full frozen 168.

temporalHoldout.split: Chronological in documented-gate-input-parity rows: first 10 fire-time rows train, last 5 holdout; boundary after 2026-09-25T13:07:27.579Z
temporalHoldout.interpretation: Exploratory only: five holdout entries, three complete 72h windows and two censored; no adequate temporal validation.

limitations: Threshold candidates are exploratory and retrospective; no live threshold change is recommended.
Only 21 immutable single_entry_v1 rows; 147 older cohort rows are not retrospectively assigned a gate version or fire-time metric classes.
Six 72h windows are incomplete and right-censored; already-observed >=10% is still a success, but an unreached threshold is not a final failure.
The CVD input-parity subset of 15 is derived from persisted fire-time values, not a stamped gate-version cohort.
Fixed 72h forward high is the primary peak measure; tracker peak through closure is separate and statuses/PnL remain CSV-frozen.

selection.grouping: Frozen CSV entry_policy_version == single_entry_v1 => single_entry_v1_21; all other frozen cohort rows => legacy_147

source.selection: Bounded SELECT for the frozen 168 IDs; returned only ID and stored text class columns, with SQL NULL and empty text tagged separately.
source.query: SELECT id, CASE WHEN plm_fut_taker_shadow IS NULL THEN '<SQL_NULL>' WHEN plm_fut_taker_shadow = '' THEN '<EMPTY>' ELSE plm_fut_taker_shadow END AS plm_fut_taker_shadow, CASE WHEN plm_oi30m_shadow IS NULL THEN '<SQL_NULL>' WHEN plm_oi30m_shadow = '' THEN '<EMPTY>' ELSE plm_oi30m_shadow END AS plm_oi30m_shadow FROM tracked_signals WHERE id = ANY($1::integer[]) ORDER BY id
source.classification: Stored text labels only; no numeric metric thresholds used to reconstruct a missing class.
source.statusSource: Frozen CSV .local/reports/plm-cohort-2026-10-01.csv; statuses were not read from mutable tracker rows for this cross-tab.

storedShadowClasses.note: Legacy and single_entry_v1 classes are separate. Current-cohort shadow readiness and fixed-72h peak results are not pooled with legacy status/class counts; raw frozen peak and status fields remain unchanged.
